notes.title: Patch V0.2.51_DEMO
notes.notes:
Heyo BOTSU Brawlers!
We've got another patch live today, V0.2.51_DEMO which introduces more improvements to the game and bug fixes!

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f94a.png"]Improvements

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f91a.png"] Reduced the strength of throwing other characters to help balance sumo

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/23f3.png"] More time to vote for the next match (+2 seconds)

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/27a1-fe0f.png"] Pressing the scoreboard button (Tab) now shows emotes, too

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f518.png"] Showing scoreboard controls on the match win screen

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f515.png"] Removed showing “Player123 left” notification as it was distracting

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f41e.png"] Bug Fixes

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1faf3.png"] Fixed sometimes stuck grabbing onto nothing

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/2049-fe0f.png"] Fixed adding the anonymous suffix “-???” to some players who were not anonymous

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/2753.png"] Fixed some players having the anonymous suffix “-???” twice after their names

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f4a5.png"] Fixed one cause of players being thrown miles of out-of-bounds, from jumping off fast moving objects

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1fae5.png"] Fixed scoreboard overlapping with text on win screen


Thank you for all your feedback so far! Keep them coming!

Make sure to 👉Join the Discord to help us squish any more bugs that appear through the cracks!

notes.title: 🤖 BOTSU IS BACK! - Demo update & more mayhem!
notes.notes:
Missed the chaos? Don’t worry, we brought it back! 
The BOTSU demo is LIVE again for the PC Gaming Show, and guess what? A brand-new trailer just dropped too! 🎉 Don’t say we don’t spoil you 😜

[previewyoutube="bp-7deYlZjc;full"][/previewyoutube]

What’s New in the Demo? 🛠️
Oscar has been hard at work under the hood (and also under a pile of bots) to bring you a more refined demo!

Fight for the BOTSU CUP 🏆

Introducing a NEW 3-match circuit - best out of three wins you the set! 

Party in the City 🕺

You’ll find other players dropping into the home area now, so make some friends or…suss out your competition early

All New Scoreboard 🥅

A new scoreboard widget has been added for tracking teams and also your personal star performance 

Who’s That? 👾

Clearer UI & nametags so you can instantly tell who’s a bot and who’s just bad at the game

Straight into the action 💥

After you finish the tutorial, hop right onto the express train to the match stadium, meaning less faffing and more yeeting

No More Lag 🐌

Smoothed out latency issues for better robot performance

Improved logic to better identify near vs far hosts (hopefully no more mystery lag!)

New Emotes! 😭

We’re excited to be a part of the PC Gaming Show and even more excited for you to try out the new and improved demo!



The fun is just getting started, more chaos is coming and we want you to be a part of it! So, come and join us over in the BOTSU Discord , provide feedback to Oscar directly and share your insane plays (or epic fails) with others. 



BE THERE, BE SQUARE 🤖🧊

PLAY THE DEMO NOW
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2717930/BOTSU_Demo/"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: V0.1.19 🐞Bug fix patch
notes.notes:
🤔 Known Issues

 Steam Deck version crashes when joining a game. The issue doesn’t appear to be from this update, possibly on Steam’s side, as older versions are affected too. Currently investigating. 
 If this happens to you, please let me know on this Steam Forum thread

🪲 Bug Fixes

 Fixed players spawning in wrong places on the Next Match Voting screen and Trophy screen when players changed team or joined/left.
 Fixed stockpile crowd cheering constantly at full volume.
 Fixed floor and wall boundary effects not showing.
 Finally fixed the goal score effect that fills the stadium with the team colour!

notes.title: V0.1.14 - ⚽🥊🏠 Balancing, Sandbox, Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
⚽ Boxball

Boxball travelling explosion now destroys attached grappling hooks, so the travelling and grab times are enforced for grappling hooks.

🤼 Sumo

Increased sumo starting booster fuel from half tank to full tank.
Fixed lava disappearing sometimes for joined players.

🥊Boosting & Grabbing After Taking Hits

Boosting is now interrupted by taking hits, for 0.66s.
Boost cooldown time after taking hits reduced from 2s to 0.66s.
Grab cooldown time after taking hits reduced from 1s to 0.66s.

🏠 Home Area

Added gadgets to home playground area. Can you find all 4?
Added booster fuel to the home area.
Added shadows for lights inside the train carriage.
Train signs now say “Matchmaking” to make it clearer.
Added a train sign when leaving tutorial.
Train now comes out of a dark, dark tunnel.
Fixed some missing collision on the train carriage doors.
Upgraded beach ball.

🎬 Replays

Fixed corrupt replay recordings if joined a match (when not a host).
Fixed bug where recent replay recordings do not get cleared from disk unless opening the replay menu.

💾 Player Progress Save Backups

Fixed bug where the game cannot start if the player save data had been corrupted due to a crash.
If player save data becomes corrupt, it will now use very frequent backups, and a less frequent backup on startup to ensure that the player save data is recovered without losing a lot of progress.
Added confirmation and error messages when renaming a player profile.

notes.title: V0.1.13📦Content Update! 🧙‍♀️Outfits + 🧗Grappling Hooks + 🚀Sumo Boosters!
notes.notes:
💬Join the BOTSU Discord for more updates!

Outfits

Punk
Sk8er

Tortoise
Ballerina
Shark

notes.title: V0.1.11 🎈📦🚀 Balloons, Boosters, Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone for Botsu’s first Multiplayer Madness event and giving lots of feedback!! You’re awesome!
This update includes fixes for the main issues people found, and I’ll be working through the rest of it for new updates soon. Thanks again!

Match Generation

Balloons are much more likely to be included in matches now (25% -> 66%)
Stockpile can have boosters now (0% -> 50%)
Initial match list for new players improved to include more variation

Match Introduction UI

Instructions for game modes are much more prominent now, with larger font size and animations for emphasis

Online Multiplayer

If finding or joining a match takes too long (usually caused by host quitting as you join), a button will appear to host your own instead
Commentary text for “RCKT PETUNIA ballooned you!”, “WOBBLY MACNABB threw you!” and others working in online multiplayer matches now

Controls Settings

Enabling Gamepad 1 as Player 2 split-screen controls setting (Player 1 keyboard only) now requires changing the setting with keyboard/mouse, to prevent being locked out of Player 1’s split-screen on devices without keyboard/mouse e.g. Steam Deck.

Bug fixes

Fixed incorrect FoV tooltip
Fixed music staying muted when joining a match via steam invite

notes.title: V0.1.8 – Online Match Flow and UI Update
notes.notes:
Online Multiplayer Match Flow

Team selection is now maintained between matches
Joining a match via the train is now smoother, showing loading screen that says “Finding Matches…”
If you have joined a match and the host leaves, you will now see “Migrating host” and the match will quickly resume with you as a host, with the same mode, arena, score, time and bot players. Previously it would start a new, different match from the start
If you become disconnected from a match for any reason, your XP will be kept for you and awarded at the end of the next match you complete in that play session 
Fixed host pausing other players during multiplayer matches after disconnected from host

Sumo

When spectating after falling into lava in sumo, you can switch between the players you are spectating now with mouse buttons, keyboard arrows, keyboard W, E, controller d-pad or shoulder bumpers

Boxball

Fixed boxball cube sometimes invisible for first round of boxball match if joined another player online

UI/HUD

Gadgets on HUD now include their button icon to show you what to press
Added “XP” suffix to xp popups on HUD so the numbers are not confused with round points or match score
End of match podium screen community and wishlist buttons at bottom of the screen no longer conflict with character controls on that screen
Added “Exit to Desktop” button from settings tab of pause menu so it can be used during matches
Game now remains visible in background, when not focused, including on additional monitors
Web pages open in steam overlay browser instead of opening up a new default browser tab
Developer feedback button moved up in the menu
Reworded wishlist screen back button

Audio

 Fixed level-up screen and recovery button mash sounds being silent after first match

Known issues

Graphics settings screen FPS display does not update, so always says 60. Until this is fixed, please use Steam FPS display, or press CTRL+ALT+, (comma) to enable debug overlay

notes.title: V0.1.7 – Host Disconnect Flow Update
notes.notes:
Online Multiplayer Match Flow

 When you are unexpectedly disconnected from a match (host ended it), you will immediately proceed to another match, instead of be kicked out to the home space
 When a host leaves a match to go back to the home space, the other online players will go to new matches instead of home with the host

notes.title: V0.1.6 – The Eardrum Update
notes.notes:
Audio

 Added overall volume control
 Fixed some very loud sounds in rewards screen,  knock-out recovery and boxball hold beeps

Matches

 Preventing 2 matches in a row with same game mode
 New players get a set of 3 pre-defined matches before going on to generated matches
 Fixed multiple “Match Completed” and other XP awards in a row at end of match

Stockpile

 Stockpile changed from best of 5 to best of 3 so duration is more similar to other game modes

Sumo

 Fixed spectating sumo bots hugging for ages after human players are out
 “Pacifist” XP Award is now only for round survivors in Sumo, not just anyone who didn’t hit

Tutorial

 Fixed falling to infinity at the top of tutorial gadget room
 Fixed having to return to coach at end of tutorial if you run ahead
 Fixed having coach telling player to pick up boost fuel when they have already crossed

UI

 Made it easier to tell which button is hovered, especially when there are only 2 options, by making chevrons dance to the music
 Replay mode controls now include button icons and mouse keyboard version
 Fixed repeated unlocks display at level 4
